title: Grandiose
problem: The text says your creatures act as if they have 3 more buffs, debuffs and minions. The +3 is only added inside the shared counters (bc_CountBuffs / bc_CountDebuffs / bc_CountMinions). A set of effects counts the raw buff/debuff list instead, so they never see the +3: with Lenience and 17 buffs the creature takes 17x, not 20x, less damage. The same sites also miss Redefined (1552, 'count debuffs as buffs and vice versa') and the perk-630 term, which live in the same counters. Minions are fine: nothing reads the minion list directly. (3a/3b are SU-0160; 3c is not in it.)
notes: Text: At the end of your creatures' turns, their turn counter increases by 3 additional turns. In addition, your creatures act as if they have 3 more buffs, debuffs, and minions than ... Evidence: Counters: bc_CountBuffs 0x140689e20 (1982 gate + 1552 + perk 630), bc_CountDebuffs 0x14068d0c0, bc_CountMinions 0x14068ec50 (bc_GetCreatureMinions has 0 callers). Raw-count readers (list fetch then count read): Lenience (perk 100) bc_EventDamage L2487-L2489 @0x140e1a071 (count @0x140e1a30d); Holy Might (perk 99) L5144-L5147 @0x140eadf77; Reckoning (686) L902-L905 @0x140dc5bd5; Pandemonium Exploit (777) L4077-L4080 @0x140e72f7d; Under Stress (865) bc_CreatureAttack L1401-L1402 @0x1406df0f1 and bc_EventDamage L5752-L5753 @0x140ecf85e; Swell (866) bc_OnAttack L2081-L2083 @0x14138231a; Nighttaker (perk 120) L1868-L1869 @0x140dfa2b9; Ruin (perk 184) L2786-L2787 @0x140e28fd3 and L5497-L5498 @0x140ec0a4b; Daybreaker (perk 121) L4124-L4125 @0x140e7559c; Heresy (perk 85) L5224-L5225 @0x140eb24c9; two spell effects in bc_CreatureCast L8705-L8706 @0x1408931b4 (+10% per buff) and L9543-L9544 @0x1408b2eca (chance per debuff). Premonition's fetch (L2501 @0x140e1ac21) does not read the count. Full caller list: scratchpad errata2/b5/callsites.json. Fix sketch: At each raw-count site listed, redirect `call bc_GetCreatureBuffs` / `call bc_GetCreatureDebuffs` to a C hook. The hook calls the original, then returns an array whose count equals bc_CountBuffs(c) / bc_CountDebuffs(c) for the same creature; these sites read only the count, not the contents. That gives them Grandiose +3, Redefined and the perk-630 term at once. Do NOT redirect the iterating sites (dispel / transfer / random-pick loops: bc_CreatureCast L2074, L2091, L3443, L3471, L3502, L3527, L3546, L8132, L12106, L12122, L14822, L17580-L17676; bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L2553; bc_EventBuff; bc_OnBuffDebuff relic 11; scr_MacroProcess; bc_ArtificialIntelligence). Pairs with SU-0160 (enemy-side +3): once that lands, Nighttaker / Ruin / Daybreaker / Heresy / Swell (which count enemies' debuffs) pick it up too. Reasoning: The text claims a general 'act as if' for buffs, debuffs and minions, so any count-based effect that misses it contradicts the text (ruling 1). The miss is structural: these sites fetch the list and read its count instead of calling the shared counter that holds Grandiose. Routing them through the counter fixes it in one pattern, and fixes the same gap for Redefined. App note (unpatched game): Grandiose's +3 buffs/debuffs is not seen by effects that count the raw list, such as Lenience, Holy Might and Under Stress. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patched (batch J, 2026-10-26; group heavy): the 14 raw-count list fetches (bc_GetCreatureBuffs: bc_EventDamage L2488 Lenience @0x140e1a071, L5144 Holy Might @0x140eadf77, L902 Reckoning @0x140dc5bd5, L4077 Pandemonium Exploit @0x140e72f7d, bc_CreatureCast L8705 @0x1408931b4; bc_GetCreatureDebuffs: bc_CreatureAttack L1401 Under Stress @0x1406df0f1, bc_EventDamage L5752 Under Stress @0x140ecf85e, bc_OnAttack L2081 Swell @0x14138231a, bc_EventDamage L1868 Nighttaker @0x140dfa2b9, L2786 / L5497 Ruin @0x140e28fd3 / 0x140ec0a4b, L4124 Daybreaker @0x140e7559c, L5224 Heresy @0x140eb24c9, bc_CreatureCast L9543 @0x1408b2eca) -> hook_j_su0275_buffs / _debuffs: after the original fetch, the fresh list's count (list[0]) is set to bc_CountBuffs / bc_CountDebuffs of the same creature (only when the list is unshared, reference count 1, and its count is a number). The builder checks that every one of these sites reads nothing but list[0] before the local is reassigned (Reckoning: through the instance variable count2, read once). Iterating sites (dispel / transfer / random pick) are untouched. Enemy-side counts follow SU-0160. | 2026-10-26 in-game crash (user): GML error 'trying to index variable that is not an array' in bc_CountBuffs line 9, via bc_EventDamage L2488 from bc_CreatureStartOfTurn. The hook overwrote list[0] of the array the fetch returned, assuming a fresh copy (reference count 1); the fetch can return the creature's own stored list, so a real buff entry was replaced by a number. Patch now default off (status needs-hook) until rebuilt without writing into game arrays. | Rebuilt (batch J, 2026-10-26; group heavy, default on) after the in-game crash; nothing writes into a game array or game-owned value any more. The 14 list fetches (same sites as above) go to pass-through hooks hook_j_su0275_buffs / _debuffs: they call bc_CountBuffs / bc_CountDebuffs on the same creature, run the original fetch untouched, and record (the returned array's identity, its list[0], the counter) in a 32-entry ring inside the DLL. Each site's single list[0] read (the array element read helper 0x14028c820, index 0: Lenience L2489 @0x140e1a30d, Holy Might L5145 @0x140eae1e8, Reckoning L903 via count2 @0x140dc5c24, Pandemonium Exploit L4078 @0x140e72fa7, bc_CreatureCast L8706 @0x140893213, Under Stress L1402 @0x1406df1df / L5753 @0x140ecf952, Swell L2082 @0x1413823a0, Nighttaker L1869 @0x140dfa2e3, Ruin L2787 @0x140e28ffd / L5498 @0x140ec0a75, Daybreaker L4125 @0x140e75626, Heresy L5225 @0x140eb2539, bc_CreatureCast L9544 @0x1408b2ef4) goes to hook_j_su0275_elem: it runs the original read and, when the array matches the newest record and its list[0] still equals the recorded value, returns a pointer to a fresh real (DLL-owned) holding the counter; otherwise the original pointer. The builder checks per site: the read is the only use of the list before the local is reassigned, the returned pointer only feeds a read-only helper (copy / += / * / <= / +) with a stack-temp out, and nothing jumps into the fetch-to-read window from outside (Swell: its loop back-edge re-reads list[0] as the loop condition, so records are not consumed by a read). Call retargets only (no jump-over edits; skip audit clean).

release_notes.intended: Your creatures act as if they have 3 more buffs, debuffs, and minions than they actually have.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, several effects counted buffs or debuffs directly and never saw the 3 extra (nor Redefined's swap): Lenience, Holy Might, Reckoning, Pandemonium Exploit, Under Stress, Swell, Nighttaker, Ruin, Daybreaker, Heresy, and two spells that scale per buff or per debuff.
release_notes.fix: Now these effects use the same buff and debuff counts as everything else, so Grandiose (and Redefined) apply to them.
